OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY 
Fox Corporation 
 
Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking. 
 
 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Job Duties :
 Fox Cable Network Services, LLC seeks a Software Developer (Senior Salesforce Developer) to design, develop, and implement intelligent, data-driven salesforce solutions that enhance business efficiency and user experience across FOX divisions.  Play an essential role in bringing AI capabilities to life – integrating salesforce agent force, generative AI, and predictive analytics into FOX’s enterprise ecosystem.  Apply AI to real business scenarios at FOX, such as workflow automation for live event production and content operations as FOX’s own internal development lifecycle.  Specific duties include: 1) Design and develop custom Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Visualforce.  2) Architect and implement AI-driven solutions using Salesforce AgentForce (Bots, Prediction Builder, Next Best Action) and external AI/ML platforms.  3) Integrate Salesforce with generative AI, NLP, and predictive analytics services to deliver smarter, automated workflows.  4) Lead the full software development lifecycle — from requirements and architecture to development, testing, and CI/CD deployment.  5) Write high-quality, scalable, and maintainable code that aligns with Salesforce best practices and enterprise standards.  6) Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior developers and collaborating closely with architects, analysts, and administrators.  7) Troubleshoot complex technical issues and performance challenges across multiple Salesforce orgs and integrations.  8) Stay current with Salesforce releases, AI advancements, and emerging technologies to identify new opportunities for innovation and automation.  Telecommuting permitted from any location in the U.S.
  
 Job Requirements :
 Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, plus five (5) years of progressive, post-baccalaureate Salesforce development or related experience developing and configuring in Salesforce, including experience in Salesforce AI and custom AI/ML integrations
  
 Experience must also include two (2) years of experience integrating with external services and leveraging modern web technologies such as JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
  
 *Specific skills: Also requires experience or knowledge in the following: 1) Experience with Apex, LWC, Visualforce, SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP); 2) Knowledge of Salesforce data architecture, security, and sharing models; 3) Knowledge of Salesforce CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub, Jenkins or Copado; and 4) Experience using AI-powered development tools such as Cursor IDE and GitHub Copilot
  
 *Any level of experience or knowledge in the specific skills is acceptable.
  
 Telecommuting permitted from any location in the U.S.
  
 Must also have a certification in Salesforce Platform Developer I or II.

 #LI-DNI
 
 
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law. 
 
Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $189,051.00-207,956.00 annually. This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. Benefits for Union represented employees will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.
